I answered Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

That comes from Pree's own message in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. They wrote that the Pine Crossing morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift, and that a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce it with the store login.

I couldn't find a site code or address for Pine Crossing in anything Pree can see, so I told them to get it from store ops if the sheet needs one. I only used the #central-team channel (Pree is a member) and the public Central team digests. I didn't use `search_messages`, other channels or any direct messages.
